alt: Three boxes: missing code goes to the shop, a Rockstar Store order goes to Xsolla, and an account problem goes to PlayStation Support.

cards.title: Missing code
cards.body: If the box has no code, go back to the shop you bought it from.

cards.title: Rockstar Store order
cards.body: If you bought it on the Rockstar Store, contact Xsolla.

cards.title: Account problem
cards.body: If the code is fine but the account cannot redeem it, contact PlayStation Support.
